name: Ollama
description: Get up and running with Llama 3, Mistral, DeepSeek, and other large language models locally with a single command.

name: llama.cpp
description: Port of LLM inference in pure C/C++ with zero dependencies; powers most local LLM tools and defines the GGUF format.

name: LM Studio
description: Discover, download, and run local LLMs with an intuitive chat interface and local OpenAI-compatible REST server.

name: Jan
description: Open-source, offline-first ChatGPT alternative running 100% locally on your device with multi-engine backend.

name: vLLM
description: High-throughput and memory-efficient LLM serving engine using PagedAttention, continuous batching, and chunked prefill.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA), AMD (ROCm), AWS Neuron, CPU

name: SGLang
description: High-performance serving framework for large language models and multi-modal models with RadixAttention for fast prefix caching.

name: Open WebUI
description: Feature-rich, self-hosted AI interface for Ollama, vLLM, and OpenAI-compatible APIs with RAG, web search, and voice.

name: Kobold.cpp
description: Single-file, zero-dependency executable for local LLM inference, text generation, and roleplay with built-in web UI.

name: ExLlamaV3
description: Optimized quantization and inference library for running LLMs locally on modern consumer GPUs, using the new EXL3 quant format; successor to the now-archived ExLlamaV2.

name: TextGen (oobabooga)
description: Open-source desktop app and Gradio web UI for local LLMs with text, vision, and tool-calling support, plus an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API; renamed from text-generation-webui in 2026.

name: LocalAI
description: Drop-in REST API replacement for OpenAI APIs supporting local text generation, voice (TTS/Whisper), and image generation.
hardware_reqs: CPU, CUDA, Metal, ROCm, Intel GPU

name: Tabby
description: Self-hosted AI coding assistant offering an open-source alternative to GitHub Copilot with IDE extensions and model serving.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA CUDA GPU, Apple Silicon, CPU

name: OpenHands
description: Self-hosted autonomous AI software engineer that plans
license: and runs code in a sandboxed Docker environment via CLI or web GUI; keeps your code on your own machine.
tags: CPU (Docker); GPU only if self-hosting the LLM

name: AnythingLLM
description: All-in-one desktop and Docker AI app combining RAG, no-code AI agents, and multi-model, multi-user chat over local or remote LLMs.
hardware_reqs: CPU; NVIDIA/Apple Silicon GPU optional for local embeddings/LLM

name: Unsloth
description: Fast, memory-efficient LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning library with hand-written Triton kernels; ships Unsloth Studio, a local no-code UI for training and exporting models.
hardware_reqs: NVIDIA CUDA GPU (consumer cards from ~8GB VRAM)

name: Text Embeddings Inference
description: Hugging Face's high-performance embedding and reranking server with an OpenAI-compatible API, supporting BGE, E5, GTE, Qwen3, and Gemma embedding models fully offline.

name: ComfyUI
description: Node-based graph interface for running Stable Diffusion, SDXL, SD3.5, and Flux image/video diffusion models entirely on local hardware.

name: LocalAGI
description: Self-hostable AI agent platform and drop-in replacement for OpenAI's Responses API, pairing with LocalAI for fully offline agent orchestration on consumer hardware.
